analysis.visual_description: On the part. A narrow part on the desk at the lodging. Three cues sit in another hand. The lines under them are not spread out for a reader.
On the part. The same roll. Nothing is written above the cues as a name. The hour is in the margin.
On the part. The comedy's book shut beside the roll. The pause-mark is inside, and the book is not opened. The part is the one he takes.
